tagline: Differentiated energy company delivering value through disciplined, returns-driven growth
hero_kpi_rationale: Crescent actively refinanced its debt in 2025 with the issuance of $600 million of 8.375% senior notes due 2034, while repurchasing $500 million of notes due 2028 at an average price of 104.472%. This proactive capital structure management strengthens financial flexibility and extends the debt maturity profile.

kpis.name: Senior Notes Issued 2034
kpis.explanation: Principal amount of 8.375% senior notes due 2034 issued in July 2025
kpis.description: Issuance of $600 million of 8.375% senior notes due January 2034, with net proceeds of $588.1 million after fees
kpis.signal: Strengthened liquidity profile and debt maturity management

kpis.name: 2028 Notes Repurchased
kpis.explanation: Principal amount of 9.250% senior notes due 2028 repurchased through exchange offer and tender
kpis.description: Repurchase of $500 million in 2028 notes via exchange offer ($306.1 million) and tender offer ($193.9 million) at an average price of 104.472%

kpis.name: Debt Extinguishment Loss
kpis.explanation: Net loss recognized on the repurchase and exchange of senior notes
kpis.description: Debt extinguishment loss of $29.2 million, including write-off of associated financing fees

kpis.name: 2029 Notes Outstanding
kpis.explanation: Remaining principal amount of 7.750% notes due 2029 after the Vital exchange offer
kpis.description: 7.750% senior notes due 2029 consist of $2.9 million of Vital 2029 notes and $294.8 million of Crescent 2029 notes

kpis.name: 2030 Notes Outstanding
kpis.explanation: Remaining principal amount of 9.750% notes due 2030 after the Vital exchange offer
kpis.description: 9.750% senior notes due 2030 consist of $65.0 million of Vital 2030 notes and $237.2 million of Crescent 2030 notes

risks.title: Manager Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is managed by an external manager, which may create conflicts of interest and dependency risks.

risks.title: Governance Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is a controlled company (as defined by NYSE), which may create governance risks and conflicts of interest.

risks.title: Reputational Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company may be affected by reputational issues in the event of failure to meet governance standards or conflicts of interest.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations as an oil and gas enterprise, which may create compliance risks.

risks.title: Key Personnel Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on certain key individuals, which may create risks in the event of their departure or loss.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company may be involved in litigation, which may result in cost and reputational risks.

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Revenues and operating results are significantly dependent on crude oil and natural gas prices, which have experienced periodic and sustained volatility.

risks.title: Inflation and Monetary Policy Risks
risks.score_rationale: Sustained inflation levels increase costs for oilfield services, labor, and equipment, impacting capital expenditures and operating costs.

ai_positioning.summary: CRGY does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
